fusions.name: Skipped Blade
fusions.desc: Skims a knife low across the ground at a target up to 7 tiles away for 3 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, with a 50% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Without a Ripple
fusions.desc: Throws a knife that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring armour and resistances, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dive Under
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you surface 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Placid Until
fusions.desc: The moment you are back at full health, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 12 seconds.
